pages.title: Foliot Miner
pages.text: Miner spirits use $(item)Dimensional Mineshaft$() to acquire resources from other dimensions.$(br) They are summoned and bound into magic lamps, which they can leave only through the mineshaft.$(br) The magic lamp degrades over time, once it breaks $()

pages.title: Foliot Miner
pages.text: the spirit is released back to $(#AA00AA)The Other Place$().$(br)
To summon miner spirits, you first need to craft a $(l:getting_started/magic_lamps)Magic Lamp$(/l) to hold them.$(br) The key ingredient for that is $(item)Spirit Attuned Gem$().$(br)

The $(#AA00AA)Foliot$() miner harvests only resources considered more basic and less precious.$(br) The mining process is quite slow, due to this the Foliot expends only minor$(br) amounts of energy, damaging the lamp it is housed in slowly over time.$()
